He finds out that the Bennett sisters live in the apartment next door to his, and since Emma had taken to Akito, the Bennett sisters start coming over to Akito's place every day. In the midst of all this, there were three daughters who were dubbed "the villainesses," in reference to a popular story. Seraphina, the crown prince's fiancée and the daughter of an upright marquise. Sandra, the noble daughter of a viscount who made their wealth from commerce. Bernardetta, the brilliant daughter of the current Prime Minister's who is a marquise. When a sense of disquiet begins to grow in the school, these women finally stand up! title: Sotsugyou Album no Kanojotachi
titleNative: 卒業アルバムの彼女たち
synonyms: The Heroines in My Graduation Albums
synopsis: Movie otaku Meguru Kanae had potential love interests in elementary, junior high, and high school, but he never made a move due to his lack of experience in love. Disillusioned by his past experience, he vows to devote all his energy to the Movie Club at university and forgo romance altogether. However, his resolution is short-lived, as he falls in love with Sora Ootsuka as soon as he walks into Movie Club. This is the start of a romantic comedy that will sweep all the love flags away! (Source: Magapoke, translated)
